body.heading: Where in the world is Nicaragua?
paragraphs: Nicaragua is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Nicaragua is Managua.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Nicaragua is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Nicaragua is the Nicaraguan córdoba.

body.heading: How big is Nicaragua?
paragraphs: Nicaragua covers about 130,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Granada is a colourful colonial city on the great lake, where boats tour 365 tiny islands formed by a volcano's eruption.
Ometepe is an island of two volcanoes rising from Lake Nicaragua — families hike to waterfalls, kayak and spot monkeys in its forests.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Nicaragua on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Nicaragua in one breath: a country in Central America, capital Managua, where people speak Spanish and pay with the Nicaraguan córdoba.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Nicaragua)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
